text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (December 17, 2025) for 4 Sherbourne Street North.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (December 17, 2025), for 4 Sherbourne Street North, Folder No. 25 212996 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to April 30, 2026.
